title: 3BR East Nashville | Stylish Stay Near Downtown
description:
Welcome to Vibe & Vinyl — a stylish 3-bedroom East Nashville retreat designed for unforgettable Nashville stays. Perfect for girls trips, family getaways, and groups, this music-inspired home sleeps up to 10 guests with cozy spaces to relax after exploring the city.

Enjoy a peaceful escape just minutes from the best of Nashville—from award-winning dining to live music and local charm. Every detail has been designed with your comfort in mind, making it the perfect retreat for families & groups.

The space
Our townhome will sleep 10 people, 12 if you choose to use the air mattress we have provided. We have 3 full bathrooms as well as a 2-car garage. We have been able to fit an Infiniti QX80 and a KIA Telluride with strategic parking (we have seen individuals with large trucks back in, but then they have to leave the garage door open.)

Guest access
The entire townhome is available for your group as well as a 2-car garage.

Other things to note
Minimum age to book is 23. Proper identification will be required.
